name: Barky
check: Alpha Wolf of the Ruins. The zipper says otherwise.

acts.label: Cringe Check
acts.text: * You stare directly at the zipper on Barky's back.
acts.repeatText: * You stare again. Barky is out of blush.
useTexts: * You stare directly at the zipper on Barky's back.
* You stare again. Barky is out of blush.
acts.response: H-hey! It's an artisanal design feature, b-baka!
useResponses: H-hey! It's an artisanal design feature, b-baka!

acts.label: Offer Dew
acts.text: * You crack open an ice-cold can.
acts.repeatText: * You crack open another can. It fizzes like a lobby timer.
acts.response: Citrus Blast 2012?! ...wait, how do I know that flavor?
acts.repeatResponse: ...2012. The basement. Somebody yelled 'alpha' and I looked up. ...I was twelve.

acts.label: Debate Lore
acts.text: * You recite incoherent mecha lore. Barky is bewildered.

acts.label: Laser
acts.text: * You shine a red dot on the floor.
acts.response: NO— I'M NOT— WHERE DID IT GO—

acts.label: Accept Hug
acts.text: * Barky hugs you. He smells like a gym bag. You hug back anyway.
acts.response: ...this is the best day of my life. Don't tell anyone.

stepFlavor: * Barky tugs his tail straight. It slides crooked again.
* Barky is trying very hard not to look at his own tail.
* Barky's smirk has left the building.
* Barky is one awkward comment from giving up.

extraActs.label: Comment on Tail
extraActs.text: * You point at the safety pin holding his tail on.
useTexts: * You point at the safety pin holding his tail on.
* You ask if the tail is supposed to droop like that.
* You mention the tail has been crooked since the lobby.
* You offer him a spare safety pin. For the tail.
